### Divine Interruptions
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/divine-interruptions-girlfriends-in-god-february-16-2016.html
Passage: Matthew 19:13-14
Points:
- Daily intrusions and difficult encounters are divine appointments rather than random accidents.
- God uses inconvenient disruptions to chip away at selfishness and pride.
- Believers should build margins into their daily schedules to welcome unexpected people.
- Embracing interruptions allows God to use us to encourage weary and hurting people.

### A Prayer to Lead Our Children Back to School
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-to-lead-our-children-back-to-school.html
Passage: Matthew 19:14
Points:
- The anxiety and change of a new school season offer a prompt to pray for young people.
- No legal or institutional restriction can hinder believers from bringing children to God in prayer.
- Scripture directs believers to intercede consistently for the protection and spiritual life of youth.
- Parents can ask God to guard children's minds and give them discernment to weigh what they learn against biblical truth.
